title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 prices at $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens for prompts up to 100K
subtitle: Claude Haiku 5.5 prices at $0.10/$0.50 per million, OpenAI shipped GPT-6 globally in ChatGPT alongside, morluto/rea, an MCP server giving coding agents

insights.text: Claude Haiku 5.5 (released October 7, 2026) prices at $0.10/$0.50 per million input/output tokens for prompts up to 100K, down from Haiku 4.5's $1/$5, with Anthropic citing an average ~75% cost cut. It's Anthropic's first Haiku-class model with an adjustable effort setting, and the company still recommends Sonnet/Opus 5.5 for complex agentic coding.

OpenAI shipped GPT-6 globally in ChatGPT alongside "Intelligent UI," which generates interactive buttons, calculators, and editable charts inline in chat responses instead of static text. Paid tiers (Pro/Plus/Business/Enterprise) got it first; Free/Go followed a day later.

morluto/rea, an MCP server giving coding agents reverse-engineering capability over binaries, Electron apps, APKs, and firmware, led GitHub Trending for a second consecutive day (4,655 stars today; 16,729 total, up from 2,956/10,230 yesterday). Its case-study claims are self-reported and not independently verified.
insights.source: morluto/rea README and GitHub Trending capture

insights.text: A single-sourced report (The Information, relayed by aggregators, not read directly) claims Microsoft cut planned annual Anthropic spend by over a third and Meta's internal Claude Code user count fell from roughly 60,000 to roughly 30,000, attributed partly to Meta's own coding tools. No company has confirmed these figures.
insights.source: AI Weekly / Stocktwits, citing The Information

insights.text: GitHub Trending's AI People roster shows a dense coding-agent maintenance cluster in the last 24h: Peter Steinberger (openclaw, 3 events), Dax Raad (opencode, opentunnel), Graham Neubig (OpenHands x2), Magnus Müller (browser-use x2), Nate Sesti (Continue), and Saoud Rizwan (Cline x2) — ordinary activity, not new launches, but evidence the category stays actively worked.

Hugging Face Trending's top model today is autotrust/JEV-27B-VL (2,174 likes, 1.53M downloads); Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B shows 6.76M cumulative downloads, the largest in the capture. google/embeddinggemma-2 dropped out of the top-20 after leading yesterday's capture.

Neither tracked OTT merger thread (Fox-Roku's DOJ Second Request, Paramount/WBD's settled antitrust suit) produced dated news this week; two discovery searches found no October 2026 reporting on either.
insights.source: Discovery search; Fox Corp SEC filings

insights.text: The Play Store capture is a single top-app chart (ten of thirty are browsers) without download velocity or rank history. No trend, adoption, or ASO shift is inferred from today's snapshot.
